description: This file defines the AssignClaimController class within the OrangeHRM Claim module. It extends an abstract Vue controller, incorporating traits for authentication and service container functionality. The controller interacts with PayGradeService to retrieve currency data and prepares a Vue component for rendering claim assignment interfaces.

classes.name: AssignClaimController
classes.description: Controller class for handling claim assignment functionalities, rendering Vue components with currency and employee data.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the PayGradeService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and sets up the Vue component before rendering.
